race.comment: FUKUBANA (2) was a barnstorming winner here two back, then just fell short from making it two on the bounce last time. Hitting his straps now and should be blending at just the right time from the favourable draw. HELL (7) gets weight off and has speed to burn. Expect him to head straight to the front and prove tough to reel in. FABULANTES (9) also gets meaningful weight relief and meets HELL better second-up. Can turn the tables. BOOM TORQUE (8) hasn't won for a long time but has hit the line hard in his last two. He could land in a sticky spot from the low draw if they aren't proactive early but if the gap appears he can cause a scare. NO DRAMA (12) showed signs of life in his stable debut but is unfortunately drawn awfully second-up. Has peaks that would take this out, so keeping safe.
